name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animate_spell, descriptor=full_screen_flash. Accurately describes the two-buffer full-screen strobe flash (variant 0x4A white + 0x4B colour, alternated 4x). No Ghidra address residue; 'full_screen_flash' is semantic. Matches body and both callers.
purpose: Full-screen strobe flash lead-in for high-tier offensive spells: composites two full-screen variants (white 0x4A / colour 0x4B) into two buffers and alternates blitting them four times before the per-target impact animation.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x24) stack check. (1) fd2_composite_chars_with_spell_effect_overlay renders variant 0x4A into the live back-buffer (data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr). (2) malloc(0x25680) secondary buffer; render variant 0x4B into it. (3) loop iter 0..3 (4 iterations = 8 blits): fd2_blit_rectangle(0xA0504,320, back-buffer+0x8088, 0x1C8,0x138,0xC0) then fd2_delay_ms(0x5A); fd2_blit_rectangle(... secondary+0x8088 ...) then fd2_delay_ms(0x5A) -> ~720ms strobe. (4) fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) restores the battle frame; free(secondary). param_1 (caster idx) and spell_id are consumed only by __CHK; the body ignores them (flash variant is fixed).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_animate_spell_full_screen_flash(uint32 param_1, uint32 spell_id, uint32 target_count, uint32 char_idx_array)

params.reason: Name matches actual use; no address residue.

params.reason: Name matches actual use (target id / runtime-char index array pointer); no address residue.
